messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 ALERT: GPU pool saturation detected in us-west-2. queue_length > 1200, avg_token_latency spike. autoscaler returned errors for 3 attempts. auto-ack by oncall rota. Severity: high. Pager: @oncall-matt @sara-p :rotating_light:
oncall-matt: seeing huge queue growth on the generation service (gen-srv). Requests are getting throttled with 429s and 5xx from the runtime. Full page from monitoring. dt: 2024-03-13 08:20 PST
sara-p: on it. grabbing logs + pulling recent autoscaler errors. Do we have cross-region fallback enabled for this customer tier?
oncall-matt: yes for most prod traffic, default routing policy is region-prefer then overflow to eu-west-1. But traffic-router shows route to us-west-2 still healthy. Not enough capacity upstream to accept overflow because downstream reject rate increased.
alex-r: important: autoscaler error is "scale_request_rate_limit" from cloud-provider (quota). Tried to spin up 4 gpus, got throttled. Also seeing kernel driver OOMs on a few existing nodes earlier.
jia: cheap check: can we temporarily toggle routing policy to allow immediate spillover to eu-west-1 for non-sensitive tenants? Could also enable greedy failover for 15m.
oncall-matt: agree. but need quick customer impact assessment. Customer-ops: any customers impacted?
customer-ops: we have 7 customers reporting elevated latency; 2 have started seeing request failures. All are in us-west region. Not yet customer escalations, but support queues picking up.
sara-p: posted a quick metric snapshot: 
```
gen-queue-length (us-west-2): 1200 -> 1600 in 8m
token-latency P95: 1.1s -> 4.8s
runtime-429: 30/s
autoscaler-errors: 3x scale_request_rate_limit (10:18 -> 10:25)
node-ooms: 2
```
alex-r: root cause hypothesis: cloud provider quota + sudden spike from a perf test from internal traffic. Need to confirm if internal load contributed.
ops-bot: deploy event: `perf-test/ci` ran a stress job at 10:10 targeting gen-srv-usw2, 500 concurrent sessions.
sara-p: oh that's likely it. Can we pause the stress job? Who owns that CI?
alex-r: it's likely automated from infra-perf. @oncall-matt can you check job runner and pause?
oncall-matt: pausing now. `ci-stop perf-test/ci` -> returned success. Will watch metrics.
(notify) incident-bot: manual mitigation initiated by oncall-matt: paused perf test; initiating routing spillover to eu-west-1 for tier=standard for 20m window.
traffic-bot: routing change submitted: `route-policy set gen-srv region_prefer:us-west-2 overflow:eu-west-1 override_ttl:1200s match:customer_tier in (standard)`. Change id: rchg-8472. Applying...
traffic-bot: applied to 3/4 router clusters, last cluster returning 403 from control-plane (timeout).
sara-p: manual fallback: adding a temporary Nginx-level proxy that will route to eu-west for requests matching header x-allow-overflow. Deploying quick lambda as emergency router.
alex-r: also increasing throttle budget to shed lowest-priority queued requests to keep latency for high-priority ones. Command: `rbctl throttle set gen-srv --policy=priority-based --min-reserve=0.15`.
ja: watching the queue: after pausing perf job queue growth slowed but still high. After routing change applied to 3 clusters we saw drop in queued requests by ~27%. However last router cluster still blocking so partial relief only.
ops-bot: cloud quota request in progress. ticket to provider submitted: ticket# CP-54231. ETA unknown.
customer-ops: support note drafted for affected customers with mitigations and ETA: "We're routing requests to alternate region and pausing internal perf tests. Working on capacity; may see intermittent throttling".
oncall-matt: I can manually spin up reservation nodes in us-west-2 from our dedicated capacity pool as emergency to reduce immediate pressure. Spinning up 2x A100 reserved nodes (from dedicated) now.
sara-p: do it. That should help until provider quota resolves. Also capture full autoscaler logs for postmortem.
(8m later) jia: update: dedicated nodes came online, queue length down to 320, 429s dropped to 2/s, P95 token latency 0.9s. Traffic-router full propagation took 12m due to the 4th cluster control-plane issue.
alex-r: cloud provider responded: they rate-limited new instance creation due to recent quota usage spike; they lifted soft throttling after our ticket and added a temporary bump to quota. They flagged that creating preemptible instances will still require per-account limits.
incident-bot: ACTIONS TAKEN: paused internal perf test; routing policy override to allow overflow to eu-west-1 for standard tier; manual reservation nodes added from Dedicated pool; throttle policy adjusted; provider ticket opened and temporary quota bump obtained.
sara-p: next: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) autoscaler should not hit single-provider quota -> multi-zone/multi-account strategy. 2) traffic-router should support atomic propagation or rollback; the partial application left us in degraded state. 3) add circuit-breaker to CI perf test runners to avoid hitting prod endpoints simultaneously. 4) add healthcheck to control-plane responses and alert earlier when router-cluster fails to apply.
alex-r: I'll own the provider quota/action item and the autoscaler change for multi-account.
ja: I'll own traffic-router propagation and cluster-level rollback logic.
oncall-matt: I'll draft runbook updates and hand over to @sara-p in 30m for the long tail shift.
customer-ops: sending final update to affected customers: "We've mitigated immediate impact by routing to another region and adding capacity; we're investigating why autoscaler couldn't scale due to provider-side rate limiting".
sara-p: 30m handoff: @oncall-matt, handing off with stable metrics. Queue steady at 300, P95 0.9s, 429s minimal. Please continue watch and follow the follow-ups.
oncall-matt: handoff ack. leaving for lunch. ping me if anything spikes. :wave:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (degraded service mitigated) at 1710401800. Severity downgraded to SEV3. Postmortem assigned: owners: alex-r, jia, oncall-matt.
(reacts) sara-p: :thumbsup: Good job everyone.
(reacts) customer-ops: :white_check_mark:
